title: Cotelligent Maternity and Parental Leave Policy

sections.title: Objective and Scope
paragraphs: This policy outlines the maternity, adoption, and related parental leave entitlements available to Cotelligent associates in compliance with the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 (as amended in 2017). This policy applies to all female employees and adoptive parents employed with Cotelligent.

sections.title: Maternity Leave Entitlement
paragraphs: Female employees who have worked for at least 80 days in the 12 months preceding the expected date of delivery are entitled to 182 days (26 weeks) of paid maternity leave for the first two children.
For the third child and beyond, the maternity leave entitlement is 84 days (12 weeks) of paid leave.

Maternity leave can commence up to 8 weeks before the expected date of delivery. The remaining leave is availed after delivery. The exact dates must be communicated to HR along with the expected delivery date.

sections.title: Adoption Leave
paragraphs: A female employee who legally adopts a child below the age of 3 months is entitled to 12 weeks (84 days) of paid adoption leave. The leave commences from the date of adoption.
The employee must provide legal adoption documentation to the HR department to avail adoption leave.

sections.title: Miscarriage and Medical Termination Leave
paragraphs: In the event of a miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy, a female employee is entitled to 6 weeks of paid leave from the date of the miscarriage. A medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner must be submitted to HR.
In case of a tubectomy operation, the employee is entitled to 2 weeks of paid leave. Relevant medical documentation must be submitted.

sections.title: Paternity Leave
paragraphs: Male employees are entitled to 5 working days of paid paternity leave which can be availed within 15 days of the birth of the child. Paternity leave must be applied for in ZOHO with the expected date of delivery as a reference.
Paternity leave can be availed in one go or split across two instances within the 15-day window.

sections.title: Work From Home After Maternity Leave
paragraphs: In case of establishments employing 50 or more employees, Cotelligent may offer work from home options to an employee after the expiry of maternity leave if the nature of the work permits. The duration and terms of such work from home arrangement will be mutually agreed upon by the employee and the employer.
Employees returning from maternity leave have the right to return to the same or equivalent position.

sections.title: How to Apply for Maternity Leave
paragraphs: The employee must notify the reporting manager and HR department at least 30 days before the expected commencement of maternity leave. A medical certificate from a registered gynecologist indicating the expected delivery date must be submitted to HR.
Leave must be formally applied for in ZOHO. HR will process the application and confirm the leave period in writing. During maternity leave, the employee is not required to work or be on call.
Maternity benefit (salary) is paid on a monthly basis during the leave period as per the Maternity Benefit Act.

sections.title: Creche Facility
paragraphs: As per the amended Maternity Benefit Act 2017, establishments with 50 or more employees must provide creche facilities within a prescribed distance. Cotelligent will communicate the availability of creche facilities as applicable at each office location.
The employee who has availed maternity leave is allowed to visit the creche 4 times during the working day.
